scope: Joint weekly-quiz bootstrap of the shared-boundary gap, the conservative 2023-2026 gap and their difference; reproduction of stored cross_model.json and fullscale.json gaps; year-level answer-permutation nulls for small Qwen rungs.
boundary: Static = date year < 2025; Fresh = date year >= 2025 (from `date`)

bootstrap.unit: weekly quiz id; full quiz set resampled once per draw

weightings.quiz_weighted: mean over quizzes of within-quiz means, each year/regime using only quizzes that contain questions of that year/regime

caution: A difference interval that includes zero does not show the two gaps are equal; no equivalence margin is specified.

b_full_4176.stored_estimator: fullscale_agg.block_boot: question-pooled means; the two groups' quiz sets resampled INDEPENDENTLY; B=4000; numpy RNG seeded by crc32(label); percentile CI

c_floor_permutation.null_definition: within each (year, answer-length bucket) cell, closed-book predictions are permuted among questions; null F1 = token F1 of a type-matched prediction written for a different question. p_one_sided_perm = (1 + #null >= observed)/(1 + N).
c_floor_permutation.diagnostics: exact_match_pct: normalised prediction == normalised gold. echo_stripped_f1: token F1 after removing tokens that occur in the question text from both prediction and gold (questions whose gold tokens all occur in the question are excluded and counted). The shuffle null is weak against answers assembled from question words or generic high-prior entities; these diagnostics are descriptive and have no null of their own.
c_floor_permutation.cells: (date year, gold-answer whitespace word count bucket 1/2/3+)
